text: This application proposes to amend the City of Toronto Official Plan, Zoning By-law 438-86 and City-wide Zoning By-law 569-2013 to allow for the construction of a residential development at 386-394 Symington Avenue, 405 Perth Avenue and 17 Kingsley Avenue. The application proposes a building with low-rise, mid-rise and tall building components, and consists of a 17-storey tower located at the south end of Perth Avenue, an 8-storey portion fronting onto Symington Avenue and a 4-storey portion along the east side of Perth Avenue and the south side of Kingsley Avenue. The development would have a maximum height of 60.3 metres, maximum gross floor area of 31,630 square metres, and a maximum density of 3.96 times the lot area.
